import datetime
# Labor Day is the first Monday of September
year = 2026
sep1 = datetime.date(year, 9, 1)
# Monday is weekday 0

labor_day = sep1 + datetime.timedelta(days=days_until_monday)
print(f'Labor Day 2026: {labor_day.strftime(\"%A, %B %d, %Y\")}')" 2>/dev/null || node -e "
const d = new Date(2026, 8, 1); // September 1, 2026
const day = d.getDay(); // 0=Sun,1=Mon,...
const offset = day <= 1 ? (1 - day) : (8 - day);
d.setDate(d.getDate() + offset);
console.log('Labor Day 2026: ' + d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {weekday:'long', year:'numeric', month:'long', day:'numeric'}));"
